answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring each identity to stake a refundable deposit before it reaches the haven of trusted settlement. At the horizon of every epoch, accounts sign a fresh challenge, light as a zephyr yet impossible to precompute, proving one live key per identity. Stakes are slashed for self-attestation or duplicates. Honest agents recover the stake with interest, while an attacker must fund every fake identity, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes and exceeds any gaming reward.
